Game Overview

Battlemage puts players into a pixel experience centered on unleash your inner sorcerer as you wield powerful weapons in a seemingly familiar dungeon. Face relentless monster hordes and test your skills as a Battlemage. Can you conquer the ultimate boss and escape the endless onslaught? Dive into the challenge and shape the game's future.

Battlemage keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Unleash your inner sorcerer as you wield powerful weapons in a seemingly familiar dungeon.
